mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, menu_code, enabled, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tenant_menu WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND menu_code = #{menuCode} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_menu (tenant_id, menu_code, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{menuCode}, #{enabled}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant_menu SET enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
